record.question: Person, without lawful authority, has in his possession any quantity of any intoxicating liquor, knowing the same to have been unlawfully imported, transported or manufactured; or knowing that the prescribed duty has not been paid thereon, he shall be_______.
options: liable to imprisonment or a term of not less than six months which may extend to five years and shall also be liable to fine of not less than five thousand rupees which may extend to twenty thousand rupees.

liable to imprisonment or a term of not less than six months which may extend to five years and shall also be liable to fine of not less than five thousand rupees which may extend to fifteen thousand rupees.
liable to imprisonment or a term of not less than six months which may extend to five years and shall also be liable to fine of not less than five thousand rupees.

liable to imprisonment or a term of not less than six months which may extend to five years and shall also be liable to fine of not less than five thousand rupees which may extend to ten thousand rupees.
record.explanation: Possession of unlawfully imported liquor carries six months to five years imprisonment and Rs 5000-20000 fine.
